command.name: Warden's Rally
verbatim: Each Round: 30% chance to increase your Instinct and Initiative by +20% for 1 round.
Rounds 1, 2, 4, 7: Deal Tactical Damage to 1 Enemy in the same lane (Damage Rate: +50%).
Rounds 2, 5, 8: Recover troops of 2 adjacent Allies (Recovery Rate: +30%, enhanced by Initiative).
At 6+ Stars: Rounds 1, 2: increase Tactical Damage Rate by +100% and Recovery Rate by +60%.

vanguard.name: Sentinel's Presence
vanguard.verbatim: At Level 16+ and deployed in the Vanguard Increase your Recovery Dealt by +15% and Instinct by +25. Increase Fire Damage Dealt by +16% of the Ally deployed in the Left Flank.

habits.name: Forest's Instinct
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 35% chance to increase Physical Damage Dealt (excluding Basic Attacks) by +8% and reduce Tactical Damage Received by -8% of 2 other Allies in any lane for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Wise Vigor
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase your Instinct and Recovery Dealt by +24% until the end of combat.

habits.name: Thunderous Roar
habits.verbatim: Each Round: 10% chance to grant Advantage (+20%) to 2 other Allies in any lane for 2 round(s).

habits.name: Collective Might
habits.verbatim: Start of Combat: Increase Strength by +12.5% (enhanced by Strength) of 3 Allies in any lane until the end of combat.

habits.name: Lightning Strike
habits.verbatim: Start of Round 1: 40% chance to grant First-Strike and Double-Strike, and increase Strength by +25% (enhanced by Instinct), of 1 other adjacent Ally for 3 round(s).

formation_needs: adjacent allies benefiting from First-Strike and Double-Strike
